summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International, a Suzhou-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company listed in Hong Kong with ADSs registered in the US, furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC on September 17, 2026, disclosing the posting of its 2026 Interim Report on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is a routine semi-annual reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act, containing financial highlights, management discussion, and interim condensed consolidated financial statements. No transaction, corporate action, shareholder solicitation, or strategic event is reported; prior placings and RSU schemes are referenced only in definitions. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. No risk-arb angle arises.
